listing.title: SHAMPOO BAR WITH BIOTIN, NIACINAMIDE & GINSENG EXTRACT
listing.body_text:
Biotin, also known as vitamin B7, stimulates keratin production in hair and can increase the rate of follicle growth.

Niacinamide has a vital role in growing long and strong hair due to its circulation boosting properties. It enhances the appearance and feel of hair, by increasing body, suppleness, sheen. It also improves the texture of hair that has been physically/chemically damaged by helping to build Keratin. It also enhances the appearance of dry or damaged skin on the scalp by reducing flaking and restoring suppleness.

Ginseng Extract is believed to increase the dermal cells on the scalp which, in turn, strengthens the follicles and roots of the hair. This not only encourages the new growth of strands but also prevents hair thinning and breakage.

Ingredients - Sodium Cocoyl Isethionate, Decyl Glucoside, Diacyloylethyl Hydroxyethylmonium Methosulfate, Behenamidopropyl Dimethylamine, Behenyl Alcohol, Lactic Acid, Cetyl Alcohol, Polyquaternium 10, Guar Hydroxypropyltrimonim Chloride, Caprylic/Capric Triglyceride, Tocopheryl Acetat, Niacinamide, Biotin, Panax Ginseng Extract, Phenoxyethanol, Triethylene Glycol, Phthalate Free Fragrance (IFRA Certified)

Weight - 80g

WHAT IT IS:
A restorative solid shampoo bar enriched with Biotin, Ginseng, and Niacinamide to strengthen weak strands, reduce hair fall, and promote healthy growth. Designed for combination scalp types, this nutrient-rich bar cleanses gently while nourishing follicles — giving you stronger, thicker, and more voluminous hair, all in a compact, zero-waste tin.

HOW IT DOES:
Formulated with clinically backed actives that nourish and reinforce the scalp and hair:

Biotin supports keratin synthesis and strengthens weak hair fibers.

Ginseng Extract stimulates follicles and improves blood flow to the scalp.

Niacinamide enhances texture, reduces breakage, and soothes the scalp.

Together, these actives create a powerful strengthening bar that promotes growth while keeping the scalp balanced and refreshed — for thicker, healthier, and naturally resilient hair.

WHAT IT DOES:
The Biotin Shampoo Bar (With Tin) stimulates the scalp, improves circulation, and fortifies each strand from root to tip. Biotin (Vitamin B7) boosts keratin production for stronger, fuller hair. Ginseng Extract energizes the scalp, reducing shedding and promoting growth, while Niacinamide improves elasticity, smoothness, and scalp barrier health. The result is hair that feels stronger, shinier, and noticeably thicker with every wash.
